concepts.def: Body parts: la cabeza (head), el brazo (arm), la pierna (leg), el estómago, la espalda (back).
'Me duele la cabeza' (I have a headache), 'Me duelen los pies' (My feet hurt). Note plural 'duelen'.
Healthy lifestyle: comer sano, hacer ejercicio, dormir bien, beber agua, evitar el estrés.
Bad habits: fumar (smoke), beber alcohol (drink alcohol), drogarse (take drugs), la comida basura (junk food).
Commands: ¡Come! (eat), ¡Bebe! (drink), ¡No fumes! (don't smoke). Useful for health advice.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Topic 5: Social Activities, Fitness and Health — a core area of GCSE Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Topic 5: Social Activities, Fitness and Health brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Topic 5: Social Activities, Fitness and Health.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
